rationale: The fixed implementation adds a specific guard for the case where a line feed follows a carriage return while offset is zero: it swallows the line feed and resets last_char instead of decrementing offset and emitting a line. The Logic section refers only generally to handling carriage returns, line feeds, and corner cases; it does not state this offset-zero guard, swallowing behavior, or any equivalent fixed-only condition. Its remaining claims (length check, iteration, buffering, line emission, last-character tracking, NUL handling, and return value) are true of both versions.
